rationale: The bounded user-visible product-semantics change spans three canonical owners and three source paths. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced; Verified Change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation. The supplied facts remain bounded enough for a structured slice rather than full structured delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Three canonical owners and three source paths are affected.
Derived paths exist and deterministic propagation is false.
Completed Brownfield analysis is not evidenced.
Stored quick_task context is not evidenced.
No runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact isin
